targets.rawSql: SELECT scanned_at AS "time", (raw_result->'summary'->>'score')::numeric AS score FROM scan_runs ORDER BY scanned_at;
SELECT (raw_result->'summary'->>'score')::numeric AS score FROM scan_runs ORDER BY scanned_at DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c->>'check_id' AS control, round((c->>'compliance')::numeric*100,1) AS compliance_pct FROM scan_runs, jsonb_array_elements(raw_result->'summary'->'controls') AS c WHERE scanned_at = (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM scan_runs) ORDER BY compliance_pct ASC;
SELECT key AS severity, value::int AS count FROM scan_runs, jsonb_each_text(raw_result->'summary'->'by_severity') WHERE scanned_at = (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM scan_runs);

SELECT c->>'check_id' AS control, c->>'cis_reference' AS cis_control, c->>'severity' AS severity, (c->>'total_resources')::int AS total_resources, (c->>'failed_resources')::int AS failed_resources, round((c->>'compliance')::numeric*100,1) AS compliance_pct FROM scan_runs, jsonb_array_elements(raw_result->'summary'->'controls') AS c WHERE scanned_at = (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM scan_runs) ORDER BY compliance_pct ASC;

SELECT f->>'severity' AS severity, f->>'check_id' AS check, f->>'resource_name' AS resource, f->>'description' AS description, f->>'remediation' AS remediation FROM scan_runs, jsonb_array_elements(raw_result->'findings') AS f WHERE scanned_at = (SELECT max(scanned_at) FROM scan_runs) ORDER BY CASE f->>'severity' WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
